about.info:
Based in Dubai, UAE, running Century Fasteners LLC, a fasteners trading company, and building web apps, portals and AI-powered tools alongside it.

Over the years the work has also included filmmaking, video editing, graphic design and photography, along with teaching, public speaking and coordinating school media. The folders here hold a selection of it.

“A person’s craft is their treasure.”
